flows:
Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/signup then Type "Limit Tester" into the Full name field
Type "limitw42kzo@mlyfo.app" into the Email field
Type "limitw42kzo" into the Username field
Type "kane-password-123" into the Password field
Click "Create account"

Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app/pad then Type "pay @ada 150 for rent" into the Message field
Click the "Pay $150.00" button
Assert the keyboard card says "Confirm $150.00 to @ada" and mentions the per-payment limit
Type "kane-password-123" into the "Your password" field
Click "Confirm payment"
Assert the keyboard card says "Sent $150.00 to @ada"
